name: autodl-remote
description: SSH CLI and MCP tools for AutoDL accounts, commands, files, jobs, fleets, tmux, dashboards, and shutdown.

interface.shortDescription: Control AutoDL over SSH from local Codex.
interface.longDescription: Provides a local SSH CLI plus standardized MCP tools for account and fleet management, remote command execution, optional tmux-backed long jobs, explicit file upload/download, remote job/run tracking, read-only dashboard generation, and guarded shutdown handling. Codex decides what to inspect, push, pull, and run.
defaultPrompt: Use AutoDL Remote to inspect my remote project.
Upload this edited file to AutoDL and run training.
Tail the latest AutoDL training log.
Run a long AutoDL training job in tmux and show the live pane output.
Check the status of my detached AutoDL job.
Show a read-only dashboard for my AutoDL devices and runs.
Shut down the remote AutoDL machine when the run is finished.
